This file downloads and cleans the data used in every other part of the project. 
All analyses read the cleaned file `data/sparcs_clean.csv` saved at the end.

## Download discharge data

Data come from the [Hospital Inpatient Discharges (SPARCS De-Identified): 2023](https://health.data.ny.gov/d/46xm-urtu) dataset on Health Data NY. See `data_check.md` for how we picked the five conditions.

```{r download-sparcs}
base_url = "https://health.data.ny.gov/resource/46xm-urtu.csv"

# our 5 DRGs (names have to match the data exactly)
drgs = c(
  "HEART FAILURE",
  "MAJOR RESPIRATORY INFECTIONS AND INFLAMMATIONS",
  "CVA AND PRECEREBRAL OCCLUSION WITH INFARCTION",
  "SEPTICEMIA AND DISSEMINATED INFECTIONS",
  "KIDNEY AND URINARY TRACT INFECTIONS"
)

# turn the list into a filter the API understands
where_clause = str_c(
  "apr_drg_description in(",
  str_c("'", drgs, "'", collapse = ", "),
  ")"
)

# only download our 5 DRGs, everything as character for now
sparcs_raw =
  GET(base_url, query = list(
    "$where" = where_clause,
    "$limit" = "300000"
  )) |>
  content("parsed", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

# should be 282,628
nrow(sparcs_raw)
```

## Download hospital info

Hospital ownership and locations come from the [Health Facility General Information](https://health.data.ny.gov/d/vn5v-hh5r) dataset.

```{r download-hospitals}
hosp_info =
  GET("https://health.data.ny.gov/resource/vn5v-hh5r.csv",
      query = list("$limit" = "50000")) |>
  content("parsed", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  mutate(fac_id = as.numeric(fac_id)) |>
  # some hospitals are listed twice, keep one row per hospital
  distinct(fac_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  # public vs nonprofit (no for-profit hospitals in our data)
  mutate(
    ownership = fct_recode(
      ownership_type,
      "Nonprofit" = "Not for Profit Corporation",
      "Public"    = "Municipality",
      "Public"    = "Public Benefit Corporation",
      "Public"    = "State",
      "Public"    = "County"
    ),
    latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(longitude)
  ) |>
  select(fac_id, ownership, latitude, longitude)
```

## Clean discharge data

```{r clean}
sparcs_clean =
  sparcs_raw |>
  # drop records with no hospital id 
  filter(!is.na(permanent_facility_id)) |>
  mutate(
    # ids turn into numbers to match hosp_info
    hosp_id = as.numeric(permanent_facility_id),
    
    # short names 
    condition = fct_recode(
      apr_drg_description,
      "Heart failure"         = "HEART FAILURE",
      "Respiratory infection" = "MAJOR RESPIRATORY INFECTIONS AND INFLAMMATIONS",
      "Stroke"                = "CVA AND PRECEREBRAL OCCLUSION WITH INFARCTION",
      "Sepsis"                = "SEPTICEMIA AND DISSEMINATED INFECTIONS",
      "Kidney/UTI"            = "KIDNEY AND URINARY TRACT INFECTIONS"
    ),
    
    # remove commas from money and turn "120 +" into 120
    los     = as.numeric(str_replace(length_of_stay, "120 \\+", "120")),
    charges = round(as.numeric(str_replace_all(total_charges, ",", "")), 2),
    costs   = round(as.numeric(str_replace_all(total_costs, ",", "")), 2),
    
    # severity in order: 1 = Minor ... 4 = Extreme
    severity = fct_relevel(apr_severity_of_illness,
                           "Minor", "Moderate", "Major", "Extreme"),
    
    # age groups in order
    age_group = fct_relevel(age_group,
                            "0 to 17", "18 to 29", "30 to 49", "50 to 69", "70 or Older"),
    
    # group the 9 payer types into 4
    payer = fct_recode(
      payment_typology_1,
      "Private" = "Private Health Insurance",
      "Private" = "Blue Cross/Blue Shield",
      "Private" = "Managed Care, Unspecified",
      "Other"   = "Federal/State/Local/VA",
      "Other"   = "Self-Pay",
      "Other"   = "Miscellaneous/Other",
      "Other"   = "Department of Corrections"
    ),
    payer = fct_relevel(payer, "Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Other")
  ) |>
  # add ownership and location
  left_join(hosp_info, by = c("hosp_id" = "fac_id")) |>
  select(
    hosp_id, facility_name, hospital_county, hospital_service_area,
    ownership, latitude, longitude,
    condition, severity, age_group, gender, payer,
    los, charges, costs
  )
```

## Check the cleaned data

```{r check}
# rows left (282,628 minus 184 with no hospital id)
nrow(sparcs_clean)

# stays and hospitals per condition
sparcs_clean |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarise(n_stays = n(), n_hosp = n_distinct(hosp_id))

# anything missing? (ownership should only be missing for the 6 unmatched hospitals)
sparcs_clean |>
  summarise(
    n_ownership_na = sum(is.na(ownership)),
    n_latitude_na  = sum(is.na(latitude)),
    n_charges_na   = sum(is.na(charges)),
    n_costs_na     = sum(is.na(costs)),
    n_los_na       = sum(is.na(los))
  )

# quick look at the main variables
sparcs_clean |>
  select(los, charges, costs) |>
  summary()
```

## Save

```{r save}
# everyone reads this file for their analysis
write_csv(sparcs_clean, "./data/sparcs_clean.csv")
```

## How to load the clean data

CSV files don't remember factor order, so use this code to read the data in every analysis file:
```{r load-example}
sparcs_clean =
  read_csv(
    "./data/sparcs_clean.csv",
    col_types = cols(
      severity  = col_factor(levels = c("Minor", "Moderate", "Major", "Extreme")),
      payer     = col_factor(levels = c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Other")),
      ownership = col_factor(levels = c("Nonprofit", "Public")),
      condition = col_factor(levels = c("Heart failure", "Respiratory infection", "Stroke", "Sepsis", "Kidney/UTI")),
      age_group = col_factor(levels = c("0 to 17", "18 to 29", "30 to 49", "50 to 69", "70 or Older"))
    )
  )
```
